$comment: Rift actions fixture (#197). NOT CONTENT: it lives outside content/ so neither the loader nor content:validate ever sees it, and nothing ships it. Its chapter ids are placeholders with no files behind them. It shows the rift actions and the traversal guarantees around them: a one-use crossing (the ferry rift) that a fact triggers (the beacon, lit by the lighthouse chapter's completion rule) and that is a consumed exit once crossed; a story redirect (a lighthouse setback turns the ferry toward the cove) and a party redirect (once the chart is read); a stabilize (steadying the flickering storm stair); a hidden door the party discovers and opens by an action; and a fallback path (rowing the long way round) offered only when the used-up ferry and the closed lighthouse leave the harbor no other way on. rift-actions.test.ts walks it; tools/content/campaign-graph-schema.test.mjs holds it to the schema. docs/campaigns/graph-campaigns.md (Rift actions) walks through it.
title: The Ferry Rift
blurb: A harbor, a lighthouse, a storm isle and a hidden cove, joined by rifts the party can find, open, steady and turn. Not a story: a map of every rift action.

harbor.$comment: The hub. Its chapter may have the party read the old chart (sets read_the_chart), which lets them turn the ferry rift.
harbor.title: The Harbor

lighthouse.$comment: Played once (closed). Finishing it lights the beacon, which wakes the ferry rift; finishing it badly also lets the storm turn the ferry toward the cove - the encounter acting on a rift through a completion rule.
lighthouse.title: The Lighthouse

ferry-rift.$comment: One crossing only, asleep until the beacon is lit, and drawn when used up (the consumed exit). It may be turned toward the cove: by the storm (the lighthouse's setback rule) or by the party once they have read the chart.
ferry-rift.label: Step through the ferry rift

harbor-row.$comment: The fallback: offered only while no other way from the harbor is open - once the ferry is used up and the lighthouse is done, the party rows. Without it the lint reports the harbor STRANDED.
harbor-row.label: Row the long way round

storm-stair.$comment: Unstable: there on odd visits to the isle and gone on even ones - until the party steadies it.
storm-stair.label: Climb the flickering stair

cove-door.$comment: Hidden until found (blocked hidden, revealed when crossed) and asleep until the tide song is sung: the party searches the walls (discover) and sings it open (open, which latches it), or a chapter sets tide_song.
cove-door.label: Through the door in the rock
